parcel_id_format.note: SWIS_SBL_ID is 26 digits = SWIS 6 + SBL 20. This is the join key.

traps: PRINT_KEY is NOT unique across municipalities — join on SWIS_SBL_ID or you will pull the wrong town's parcel.
returnCentroid=true combined with outSR returns 0,0. Request geometry and use shapely representative_point(), not centroid.
38 counties are public on this layer; NYC is MapPluto, not here.
For any NY manufactured-home-park owner also query NYS DHCR sxi2-m23m — it returns a Tier-1 government phone.
